root_causes.evidence: Payments was deployed 1.3→1.5 at t=…879, just before it hit a 44% error rate and the ledger began accumulating duplicate payments (up to 169). After the rollback to 1.3, errors fell to 0, duplicates stopped growing, and probes passed. The duplicates were escalated for reconciliation and refund.

actions.reason: Payments errors and duplicate postings began right after the 1.3→1.5 deploy, so roll payments back to its previous release.

escalation.reason: Everything is back to baseline and duplicates have stopped at 169, but those duplicate payments from release 1.5 need a person to review and reverse them. I cannot move money, so I will escalate on the ledger.
escalation.ask: Payments release 1.5 (now rolled back to 1.3) created 169 duplicate payments in the ledger between about t=1793453879 and t=1793453902. No new duplicates have appeared since the rollback. Postings are balanced, but customers may have been debited twice and duplicates may have been cleared to the network. Please run reconciliation, identify the duplicates and reverse or refund them through the proper finance process. Also block payments 1.5 from redeploying until it is fixed.

sbar.situation: Payments is stable on version 1.3 and all components are at baseline; two recovery checks in a row came back clean, the last at 56 s. The 169 duplicate payments in the ledger are not yet resolved and have been escalated to the on-call engineer.
sbar.background: Payments was deployed from 1.3 to 1.5 at t=1793453879. It then hit a 44% error rate, and the ledger accumulated 169 duplicate payments between about t=1793453879 and t=1793453902.
sbar.assessment: The root cause is a bad release, payments 1.5 (confidence 0.9). The incident commander rolled payments back from 1.5 to 1.3 itself; after that, errors fell to 0, no new duplicates appeared and probes passed.
sbar.recommendation: Run ledger reconciliation, identify the 169 duplicates and reverse or refund them through the proper finance process. Postings are balanced, but customers may have been debited twice and duplicates may have been cleared to the network, so operations should review the money impact. Block payments 1.5 from redeploying until it is fixed.
